name: Dawn Portal
summary: A rising sun sits within the open doorway of a bold, symmetric mosque.
why: The sun and doorway share the same central axis at x=54. The sun rests on the mosque baseline at y=72, so it belongs to the entrance rather than floating above the roof. Symmetric minarets and broad walls hold the large opening with equal weight.
risk: The rising sun becomes a small warm arch at 24px. Its meaning is clearest at 48px and above.
sub1: The hope and stillness of dawn
reasonToChoose: You want a mosque that suggests the promise of a new prayer day.
